description: Runs a full Debug xcodebuild for an Xcode project.
name: xcodebuild-full-debug-project-build
promptTemplate:
Create and execute the following shell script with `skill_execute`, passing it as `content`. Replace `{{project_xcodeproj}}` with the selected .xcodeproj path.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_XCODEPROJ="{{project_xcodeproj}}"
[ -n "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" ] && [ "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" != "{{project_xcodeproj}}" ] || { echo "Missing project_xcodeproj" >&2; exit 1; }
xcodebuild -project "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" -configuration Debug clean build
```

Return the xcodebuild output.
systemInstruction: Run xcodebuild for the selected project as a full Debug clean build.
